caption: The drawing is circular and features three people in a wooden rowboat on a body of water, depicted in grayscale with touches of muted yellow-green. One figure, standing in the center, is wearing a long dress and a bonnet, and is holding what appears to be a fishing rod. To the left, another figure is bending over the edge of the boat, handling a fishing net or possibly retrieving something from the water. The third person sits at the far end of the boat and appears to be sitting relaxed, also wearing a hat. Surrounding the boat, on both sides, there are several stylized trees with foliage highlighted in various shades of yellow-green, brown, and dark green. The water is indicated by white lines and reflections. The background within the circle is filled with light gray shading, and the scene is encircled by a rough, gray border. The rest of the page is left blank.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
